paragraphs.text: Athletico Physical Therapy’s “Don’t Fear Aging” event is scheduled for Friday, Oct. 23, from 9 to 11 a.m. at Ecru Community Center. The Town of Ecru shared the full announcement Wednesday evening, announcing a program of speakers and advertised health checks for residents.
The flyer says local speakers will offer practical information about staying healthy, active and independent. Door prizes are also part of the announced program.

Blood-pressure checks and glucose screening are listed among the activities. The event is presented by Athletico Physical Therapy; the town’s original notice is linked below for readers who want to review the full flyer.
